grammatica.evidence: Uniform openings: 'Integer, default `6`.', 'Enum, default `"mat"`.', 'Boolean, default `true`.' — stock tech-reference type/default sentence template.

dialectica.evidence: Product policies beyond type/default: 'deferred, never truncated'; 'fails closed at startup…not at first alert'; 'Covered trays are always excluded from `"top"`'.

rhetorica.evidence: Curates three TOML tables, one ### per key, type+default first; frames as 'configuration reference' where 'Every setting below shows its default' — choice among table/flat/narrative options.

arithmetica.evidence: Atomic type/default claims not public: rows int 6; cells_per_row int 8; mode enum mat/top/manual default mat; window [07:00,09:00]; channel enum log/email/none; email no default; etc.

geometria.evidence: Hierarchy: H1 → intro → ## [rack]|[watering]|[alerts] → ### setting → #### humidity_threshold under skip_when_humid; isolates one setting's block for lookup.

musica.evidence: Local cadence: punchy type/default clause, then one gloss sentence per setting — standard reference scansion, little prosodic variation.

astronomia.evidence: Flat random-access arc (rack → watering → alerts) after a short how-to-read preface; intensity stays even so one setting can be read without the rest.

notes: Telos is single-setting type+default lookup; geometria/rhetorica do the isolation work; arithmetica holds non-public facts; dialectica policies barely serve the telos.
